tools.name: whoami
tools.description: Report the name of the API key in use, the ADS Beast organization it belongs to, the scopes it carries and, in one line, whether it is read-only or can propose changes. The scope list is what a 403 from any other tool in this server refers to: a key without read:leads reaches no lead tool, whatever

tools.name: get_new_leads
tools.description: A page of leads with contact details, form answers and attribution (UTM, click ids, platform form, lead and campaign ids). Pass updated_since (ISO-8601, your last sync) to get only new or changed leads. Reply: {count, leads, has_more, next_offset, offset, limit}; page with next_offset while has_more

tools.name: get_lead
tools.description: Return a single lead by its ADS Beast id with every field the record holds, including email, phone, qualification answers, attribution and its current pipeline stage.

tools.name: list_lead_forms
tools.description: Return the lead forms recorded for this organization, which maps the form ids and source keys that appear on a lead to readable form names.

tools.name: lead_pipeline_stats
tools.description: Return aggregate lead counts by pipeline stage over a recent window, for the whole organization or for one client.

tools.name: lead_outcome_contract
tools.description: Return the field names and outcome values that push_lead_outcomes accepts, as the server currently defines them.

tools.name: update_lead
tools.description: Change fields on one existing lead: notes, assignee, contact details or pipeline stage. Only the keys supplied are written; the rest of the record is left as it is. A key that is not writable is refused with the list of fields that are, so a misspelled field cannot pass as a successful write.

tools.name: move_lead_stage
tools.description: Move one lead to a different pipeline stage. Unlike setting the stage through update_lead, this also remaps the lead's close probability to the value configured for the new stage.

tools.name: push_lead_outcomes
tools.description: Write the real outcome of leads back into ADS Beast so the ad platforms learn which leads became sales. Each row names a lead by lead_id, email or phone, and its outcome. dry_run defaults to true and reports what would change without writing; run it first. Unmatched rows are skipped unless create_mi

tools.name: list_campaigns
tools.description: Return campaigns from every connected advertising platform in one list, with their status, budget and platform ids. Archived campaigns are left out unless include_archived is true.

tools.name: get_campaign
tools.description: Return a single campaign by its ADS Beast id with its settings, budget, status and the native id it has on its platform.

tools.name: campaign_dashboard_summary
tools.description: Return spend, conversions and delivery health aggregated across the whole organization. The endpoint takes no filter and always covers every client; per-client figures come from list_campaigns with a client_id.

tools.name: list_clients
tools.description: Return the clients of this organization with their budgets, status and connected advertising accounts. A long list comes back as a page {result, total, has_more, next_offset}.

tools.name: get_client
tools.description: Return a single client by its ADS Beast id: profile, budget, goals and connected advertising accounts.

tools.name: list_reports
tools.description: Return the client reports already generated in ADS Beast, newest first, with their type, period and client.

tools.name: list_alerts
tools.description: Return the performance and delivery alerts raised by the ADS Beast monitoring agents, with their severity, the client or campaign they concern and whether they have been read or resolved.

tools.name: alerts_unread_count
tools.description: Return how many live alerts are still unread, as a single number. An alert whose condition has already cleared is not counted even if nobody opened it, so this is the number that still needs a person. Cheaper than list_alerts when only the count matters.

tools.name: list_tasks
tools.description: Return the team tasks recorded in ADS Beast with their status, priority, assignee and the client they belong to.

tools.name: list_outreach_campaigns
tools.description: Return a page of the email outreach campaigns, newest first, with their status, sender, offer pack, legal basis and daily limit. The reply is {campaigns, total, count, limit, offset, has_more, next_offset}; walk the pages with offset = next_offset. The letter itself is summarised as body_preview and

tools.name: outreach_campaign_check
tools.description: Run the pre-launch check of one email outreach campaign: who may be emailed under its legal basis, why the others are blocked (consent, personal mailbox, country, unsubscribed), and sender problems. Blocker issues stop the campaign from being activated.

tools.name: list_offer_packs
tools.description: Return the offer packs outreach copy is built from: built-in samples and this organization's own client packs, with brand, languages, niches, the facts the copy relies on and how many errors or warnings the last check found.

tools.name: list_social_campaigns
tools.description: Return the Instagram/TikTok/Facebook prospecting campaigns: offer, platforms, cities with message language, daily manual-send cap.

tools.name: get_social_queue
tools.description: Return the next business profiles to message by hand, best first, within today's remaining cap per platform: profile link, signals (books by DM, by phone, competitor tool), the drafted first message in the profile's language (no link) and the follow-up with a tracked link to send after a reply. Noth

tools.name: update_social_prospect
tools.description: Record the outcome of a hand-sent message: sent, replied, registered, declined, do_not_contact, skipped (or new to undo a mis-click), plus an optional note. Moves follow the pipeline (sent -> replied -> registered); 'sent' is refused once today's per-platform cap is used. This records a fact, it doe

tools.name: list_webhook_events
tools.description: Return the event names an outbound webhook can subscribe to, for example lead.created, with what each one carries.

tools.name: list_webhooks
tools.description: Return the outbound webhook endpoints registered for this organization, the events each one receives and its current delivery state.

tools.name: create_webhook
tools.description: Register an endpoint ADS Beast calls when a chosen event happens. From then on those records go to that URL until it is removed. Without client_id it covers every client of the organization. Deliveries carry an HMAC in X-ADS-Beast-Signature and are retried; the generated secret is not returned, so p

tools.name: seo_publish_safety
tools.description: Ask this before publishing or scheduling any article for a site. Returns its gradual-launch state: articles allowed today and already published, whether publishing is paused and why, and indexed versus kept-out articles. Rules: 2 new articles a day at start, plus 1 a week up to 6; one language versi

tools.name: list_proposals
tools.description: Change proposals waiting for a person (status pending by default), or their history. Each proposal shows what would change, why, and who proposed it.

tools.name: propose_campaign_change
tools.description: Create a change proposal for a campaign. Nothing changes in the ad account until a person approves the proposal in ADS Beast or in Telegram; the proposal expires on its own if nobody decides. State the reason with the numbers behind it.

tools.name: reject_proposal
tools.description: Reject a pending proposal with a short reason. Returns the proposal id and its new status.

tools.name: list_campaign_types
tools.description: Campaign types of the ADS Beast registry that an assistant may draft, per platform (google, meta, tiktok, linkedin, microsoft): the key to pass as campaign_type, the objective, required tracking, bid strategies and, under 'fields', exactly what a draft of that type needs with the platform's characte

tools.name: list_campaign_drafts
tools.description: Builds in the campaign builder, newest first, as summaries: name, platform, type, status (draft, ready, paused, launched), budget, how many ad groups, ads and keywords, whether an assistant created it, whether it was already published, and the cabinet link. A key bound to one client lists only that

tools.name: get_campaign_draft
tools.description: The current content of one build and a fresh validation: 'problems' block publishing, 'warnings' do not, 'launch_blockers' say why a person could not publish right now (no connected account, writing switched off), 'not_checked_here' lists what only the publish step checks. Problem texts come from th

tools.name: create_campaign_draft
tools.description: Create a campaign as a DRAFT in the ADS Beast builder: type, geo, languages, daily budget, ad groups with keywords or audiences, ad texts, landing page. Nothing reaches the ad platform. Returns the draft id, builder_url and what still blocks publishing (platform limits, ad policy, compliance); a dra

tools.name: update_campaign_draft
tools.description: Replace fields of a draft that was created with create_campaign_draft and has not been published: each field passed replaces the stored one whole (ad_groups replaces all ad groups). Returns the draft with a fresh validation. Drafts made by a person in the builder and builds that were already publish

tools.name: get_agency_kit
tools.description: The knowledge pack the agency keeps for one client: who they are, accounts and campaigns with the last 30 days of results, leads by stage, KPI goals, the write policy, the methodology of working through ADS Beast and ready prompts. Read it first when a conversation is about one client. Contains no c

tools.name: client_overview
tools.description: One client with its campaigns, key metrics and goals.

tools.name: client_action_plan
tools.description: The action plan from the client's latest weekly deep-dive audit: findings labelled confirmed, inferred or hypothesis, open change proposals and open tasks.

tools.name: client_goals
tools.description: KPI goals (ROAS, CPA, CTR, CPC) with target, current value, progress and status. Without client_id: goals of every client.

tools.name: client_data_freshness
tools.description: When each client and platform was last synced. Call it before a deep analysis so stale data is named as stale.

tools.name: client_memory_search
tools.description: Search the facts, decisions, preferences and brand notes ADS Beast has stored about clients.

tools.name: client_history_search
tools.description: Full-text search over a client's earlier reports, audits and analyses.

tools.name: client_landing_scan
tools.description: Read a landing page and extract its headline, offer, selling points, calls to action, keywords and tone. Without url, the client's own site is used. AI: 1 AI request.

tools.name: client_market_analysis
tools.description: The stored market analysis of a client: summary, competitor matrix, audience signals and the draft campaign strategy.

tools.name: client_market_analysis_run
tools.description: Crawl the client's site, find and analyse competitors and build a market intelligence report. Takes minutes; read the result with client_market_analysis. AI: 1 AI request.

tools.name: client_market_intel_search
tools.description: Semantic search over a client's indexed market data: its site, competitor profiles and the market report.

tools.name: client_market_simulation
tools.description: Status and report of the multi-agent market simulations requested for a client.

tools.name: analytics_summary
tools.description: Spend, CTR, CPA and ROAS of one client over a period. Money is reported in the account currency and never summed across currencies.

tools.name: analytics_compare_periods
tools.description: Percentage change of every KPI between the current period and the one before it, by platform, with what got worse and what improved.

tools.name: analytics_forecast
tools.description: Projection of CPA, ROAS and spend 7 and 30 days ahead from the current trend. A projection, not a promise: it extrapolates the last 14-30 days.

tools.name: analytics_forecast_warnings
tools.description: Campaigns expected to break a KPI target within days, from a linear trend.

tools.name: analytics_attribution
tools.description: Time-decay multi-touch attribution for a client's campaigns: attributed conversions, attributed CPA and the lift against last click.

tools.name: analytics_portfolio
tools.description: Cross-client analysis of the whole portfolio: best and worst performers, platform trends, total spend. Takes up to a minute. AI: 1 AI request.

tools.name: analytics_cross_client_insights
tools.description: Patterns and anomalies across clients: platforms that sag for most of them, shared niche problems, who outperforms.

tools.name: analytics_kpi_health
tools.description: Quick status of all active campaigns: how many are on target and how many need attention.

tools.name: analytics_growth_opportunities
tools.description: Campaigns ready to scale: ROAS well above target, CPA well below target, or budget left unused.

tools.name: analytics_benchmarks
tools.description: Reference CTR, CPC, CPA and ROAS ranges for a platform and niche. Benchmarks are orientation, not a verdict on one account.

tools.name: analytics_agency_briefing
tools.description: Morning briefing for the workspace: critical alerts, today's tasks and what needs attention now.

tools.name: analytics_media_plan
tools.description: A sourced chain of planning numbers for a campaign type: CPM, reach, clicks, CPC, conversion rate, conversions, CPA, break-even and three scenarios. Every figure is labelled with where it comes from.

tools.name: analytics_ab_tests
tools.description: A/B tests with their status and interim results.

tools.name: audit_account
tools.description: AI audit of a client's ad account on one platform or all of them. Takes 10-30 seconds. AI: 1 AI request.

tools.name: audit_google_ads
tools.description: Full Google Ads audit for a client: structure, keywords, responsive search ads, extensions, bidding, conversions and Quality Score problems, with a 0-100 score and recommendations. AI: 1 AI request.

tools.name: audit_meta_ads
tools.description: Full Meta Ads audit for a client: funnel structure, audiences, creatives, pixel health, conversion events, audience fatigue and Advantage+ setup. AI: 1 AI request.

tools.name: audit_conversion_goals
tools.description: Check that a client's ads learn from real leads: which Google Ads conversions are primary, whether calls and forms are counted, and campaigns optimising for the wrong goal.

tools.name: audit_tracking
tools.description: Tracking diagnostics for a client: pixel, GA4 and GTM mismatches on the landing page, conversion actions and the other tracking guards in one report.

tools.name: audit_campaign_quality
tools.description: Reads every running Google and Meta campaign of a client from the platform and checks geo, conversions against the bid strategy, moderation, landing pages and search assets.

tools.name: audit_wasted_spend
tools.description: Campaigns that burn budget: spend with zero conversions, CPA above target, no clicks. Returns the amounts lost, in the account currency.

tools.name: audit_campaign_portfolio
tools.description: Health score of every campaign, the ones in a critical state, without conversions, without goals or with stale data. A good first call before a deeper audit.

tools.name: audit_campaign_health
tools.description: A 1-10 health score for each campaign of a client with the problems behind it.

tools.name: audit_performance_coach
tools.description: A prioritised optimisation plan for a client's last 7 days from four specialist reviews (media buying, budget, audience, creative), with a confidence level per item. Recommendations only. Takes up to a minute. AI: 1 AI request.

tools.name: audit_ad_disapprovals
tools.description: Ads the platforms rejected, with the reason and the policy code.

tools.name: recommendation_list
tools.description: Open recommendation cards: agent advice and Meta's own cabinet advice, judged against the client's goal.

tools.name: campaign_search
tools.description: Campaigns filtered by client, platform, status or a substring of the name.

tools.name: campaign_analyze
tools.description: Deep analysis of one campaign: metrics, trends and recommendations. Takes up to a minute. AI: 1 AI request.

tools.name: campaign_diagnose
tools.description: Works through the possible causes of one KPI problem in a campaign: audience saturation, creative fatigue, landing page, bid strategy, seasonality, tracking.

tools.name: campaign_history_analysis
tools.description: What worked for a client before: average CPA and CTR, best campaigns and best audiences.

tools.name: campaign_type_coverage
tools.description: Which campaign types ADS Beast supports on each platform and how far: creation through the API, generation, validation.

tools.name: campaign_strategy_generate
tools.description: A strategic plan for a client over a horizon: channels, budget split, KPI targets and launch phases. Takes up to a minute. AI: 1 AI request. May return a job_id (get_job_result).

tools.name: campaign_strategy_expert_review
tools.description: Six specialist viewpoints (media buyer, copywriter, audience, competitors, conversion, data) on a planned campaign. Takes up to a minute. AI: 1 AI request. May return a job_id (get_job_result).

tools.name: campaign_swarm_runs
tools.description: Recent multi-agent campaign generation runs with status, platform and budget.

tools.name: campaign_draft_details
tools.description: A campaign draft in full: platform, type, goal, budget, UTM, targeting, ad groups with keywords and ads, and the platform campaign id once it was published.

tools.name: campaign_draft_publish_check
tools.description: Validates a campaign draft against the live ad account and reports exactly what publishing would create or change. Read-only rehearsal: nothing is written.

tools.name: google_ads_ad_strength
tools.description: Ad Strength of a client's responsive search ads: counts by level and the weak ads with Google's own action items.

tools.name: google_ads_keyword_overlap
tools.description: Finds the same keyword and match type enabled in two or more active Google campaigns of one account. Detection only.

tools.name: google_ads_script_generate
tools.description: Returns a ready Google Ads Script (JavaScript) for one campaign that a person pastes into Google Ads themselves. The tool only produces text. Amounts are in the ad account's own currency, in whole units (not cents or micros).

tools.name: google_ads_conversion_tracking_check
tools.description: Reads a client's Google Ads conversion actions and tag and reports which action fits the named conversion, or what would be created. Read-only.

tools.name: google_ads_app_videos_check
tools.description: Reads a Google App campaign and validates the videos proposed for it. Read-only.

tools.name: meta_ads_account_setup
tools.description: Pixels, pages, lead forms and conversion events of a client's Meta ad account.

tools.name: meta_ads_interest_search
tools.description: Targeting interests matching a keyword, with id, name, audience size and topic.

tools.name: meta_ads_learning_phase
tools.description: Learning status of every active ad set of a client, with what holds learning back.

tools.name: meta_ads_placement_safety_check
tools.description: Shows which ad sets of a client's active Meta campaigns still run on fraud-prone placements and what the safe targeting would be. Read-only.

tools.name: tiktok_ads_account_setup
tools.description: Pixels, identities and account details of a client's TikTok ad account.

tools.name: linkedin_ads_account_setup
tools.description: Conversions, campaign groups and account details of a client's LinkedIn ad account.

tools.name: microsoft_ads_account_setup
tools.description: UET tags, conversion goals and account details of a client's Microsoft Ads account.

tools.name: telegram_ads_status
tools.description: Connected Telegram Ads accounts, their goal and currency, and what is automated versus done by hand.

tools.name: telegram_ads_policy_check
tools.description: Checks a sponsored message against Telegram's prohibited categories, the 160-character text limit, the title limit and the link format.

tools.name: telegram_ads_verify_channel
tools.description: Whether a channel exists, is public and how many subscribers it has.

tools.name: telegram_ads_targeting
tools.description: Languages, topics with their ids and countries, read from Telegram Ads itself for one connected account.

tools.name: chatgpt_ads_status
tools.description: Connected ChatGPT Ads accounts, campaigns, ad review statuses and what blocks delivery.

tools.name: chatgpt_ads_policy_check
tools.description: Whether ChatGPT Ads policy admits this business and whether the texts fit the limits (title 50, body 100).

tools.name: creative_fatigue_report
tools.description: Campaigns of a client with high frequency and falling CTR, ranked by how tired the creative is.

tools.name: creative_image_analyze
tools.description: Reviews an ad image for platform fit, visual hierarchy, call-to-action legibility and brand fit. AI: 1 AI request.

tools.name: creative_banner_quality_check
tools.description: Reviews a generated banner of ADS Beast for garbled text, legibility, platform spec fit and visual quality, with a score and fixes. Takes up to a minute. AI: 1 AI request.

tools.name: creative_prompt_templates
tools.description: A library of prompts for generating ad banners, filtered by business vertical and visual style.

tools.name: creative_copy_humanize
tools.description: Scores a text 0-100 for signs of machine writing, lists the markers found and returns a cleaned version. It never invents facts.

tools.name: competitor_list
tools.description: Competitors on record with site, niche, collected ads and keywords.

tools.name: competitor_search_intel
tools.description: Searches the web for a competitor's ads, positioning, pricing, selling points and reviews.

tools.name: competitor_ads_research
tools.description: Competitors in a niche and country with their headlines, angles and calls to action. The response says whether an item was observed in an ad library or inferred. AI: 1 AI request.

tools.name: competitor_site_analyze
tools.description: Reads one competitor site: selling points, prices, technology, pixels, call-to-action patterns and audience signals.

tools.name: competitor_social_signals
tools.description: A competitor's recent activity outside its site: YouTube, blog feed, public posts and community mentions.

tools.name: competitor_aeo_benchmark
tools.description: Compares how often AI models mention the client versus competitors for the same prompts. AI: 1 AI request.

tools.name: leads_quality_diagnose
tools.description: Works out where a campaign loses lead quality and what to change, from the numbers and complaints supplied. Takes up to a minute. Amounts are in the ad account's own currency, in whole units (not cents or micros). AI: 1 AI request. May return a job_id (get_job_result).

tools.name: leads_meta_ingest_check
tools.description: Shows which Meta instant-form leads of a client would be imported. Read-only.

tools.name: social_calendar
tools.description: Scheduled and published social posts of a client.

tools.name: seo_research
tools.description: Keyword clusters, audience pain points, pre-purchase questions and competitor analysis for a client's site. Takes minutes. AI: 1 AI request. May return a job_id (get_job_result).

tools.name: seo_rank_changes
tools.description: Position changes over 7-30 days: winners, drops and keywords in positions 11-30.

tools.name: seo_brief_generate
tools.description: A content brief for one keyword: headings, meta tags, structure, related terms, length. AI: 1 AI request. May return a job_id (get_job_result).

tools.name: seo_keyword_rank_check
tools.description: A site's Google position for one keyword with the matched URL, SERP features and the top ten.

tools.name: seo_keyword_research
tools.description: Keyword clusters with intent, priority and AI-citation potential for a topic. AI: 1 AI request.

tools.name: seo_content_gap
tools.description: Topics competitors cover and this site does not, with an action plan. AI: 1 AI request. May return a job_id (get_job_result).

tools.name: seo_performance_report
tools.description: An SEO and AI-visibility report for a client or domain. AI: 1 AI request.

tools.name: seo_backlink_analysis
tools.description: Backlink profile quality, toxic links and link-building opportunities. AI: 1 AI request.

tools.name: seo_competitor_analysis
tools.description: Competitors' search presence, content strategy, links and AI visibility, with gaps and opportunities. AI: 1 AI request.

tools.name: seo_serp_analysis
tools.description: What ranks for a query and why: content types, featured snippets, AI overviews, People Also Ask. AI: 1 AI request.

tools.name: seo_technical_audit
tools.description: Core Web Vitals, crawlability, indexability, structured data, redirects, canonicals, mobile, HTTPS, robots.txt and sitemap. AI: 1 AI request.

tools.name: seo_on_page_audit
tools.description: One page audited across title, meta description, headings, content, keywords, internal links, images and technical basics. AI: 1 AI request.

tools.name: seo_internal_links_audit
tools.description: Orphan and weakly linked pages with the internal links to add. AI: 1 AI request.

tools.name: seo_content_quality_audit
tools.description: An 80-criteria content quality audit (clarity, organisation, referenceability, experience, expertise, authority, trust) for a URL or a text. AI: 1 AI request.

tools.name: seo_domain_authority_audit
tools.description: A 40-criteria audit of domain authority: citation, identity, trust and eminence. AI: 1 AI request.

tools.name: seo_entity_audit
tools.description: How well a brand is established as an entity for Google's Knowledge Graph and AI systems, with a plan to build it. AI: 1 AI request.

tools.name: seo_ai_citation_optimize
tools.description: Rewrites guidance for a page or text so AI answers can quote it: definition blocks, quotable statements, FAQ. AI: 1 AI request.

tools.name: aeo_visibility_scan
tools.description: How often AI models mention a client's brand for the queries of its niche: a 0-100 score, a per-model breakdown and the quotes. AI: 1 AI request. May return a job_id (get_job_result).

tools.name: aeo_mention_opportunities
tools.description: Fresh discussions where people ask for recommendations in a client's niche, with a suggested reply. AI: 1 AI request.

tools.name: reddit_mentions_monitor
tools.description: New Reddit threads mentioning a client's brand, keywords or competitors, with sentiment and a draft reply. AI: 1 AI request.

tools.name: reddit_opportunities
tools.description: Buyer-intent Reddit threads in a client's niche, ranked.

tools.name: reddit_amplification_plan
tools.description: For one page: relevant subreddits, two post drafts and the best time to post. A plan only; nothing is posted. AI: 1 AI request.

tools.name: task_create
tools.description: Create a task for the team in ADS Beast.

tools.name: task_suggest
tools.description: Scans clients for unanswered critical alerts, KPI goals at risk, campaigns without metrics and projected overspend, and creates tasks for the team. dry_run=true only lists what it found.

tools.name: report_create
tools.description: Save a report for a client. With content: stores that text (Markdown). Without content: generates a 30-day campaign summary. AI: 1 AI request.

tools.name: recommendation_save
tools.description: Record a recommendation so ADS Beast checks in seven days whether it worked.

tools.name: ab_test_create
tools.description: Register an A/B test in ADS Beast to track its hypothesis and variants. It records the test; it does not change ads.

tools.name: creative_copy_generate
tools.description: Generate ad variants (headlines, texts, calls to action) for a client and save them as drafts. Takes up to a minute. AI: 1 AI request.

tools.name: creative_fatigue_check
tools.description: Checks Meta and TikTok campaigns for tired creatives now and files an alert and a change proposal for each one found. Proposals wait for a person.

tools.name: seo_article_generate
tools.description: Writes an SEO article for a keyword and saves it as a draft. Nothing is published. Takes up to a minute. AI: 1 AI request.

tools.name: seo_content_write
tools.description: Writes search- and AI-citation-ready content on a topic and saves it as a draft. Takes up to a minute. AI: 1 AI request. May return a job_id (get_job_result).

tools.name: seo_meta_tags_optimize
tools.description: Returns improved title, meta description, Open Graph and Twitter Card tags for a page and stores the suggestion. AI: 1 AI request.

tools.name: seo_schema_generate
tools.description: Schema.org JSON-LD for a page (FAQ, HowTo, Article, Product, LocalBusiness, Organization), stored as a suggestion. AI: 1 AI request.

tools.name: seo_site_check
tools.description: Positions, technical state and a prioritised task list for a client's site; the tasks are saved in ADS Beast.

tools.name: seo_keywords_track
tools.description: Checks positions now, records them and reports changes and quick wins. AI: 1 AI request.

tools.name: seo_alerts_configure
tools.description: Set alert thresholds for traffic, positions, backlinks, Core Web Vitals and AI visibility of a domain. AI: 1 AI request. May return a job_id (get_job_result).

tools.name: aeo_content_optimize
tools.description: Reformats a client's page for citation by AI models (Q&A version, FAQ blocks, JSON-LD) and saves the recommendations. AI: 1 AI request.

tools.name: reddit_reply_draft
tools.description: Drafts a reply to a Reddit thread and saves it as a task for a person to review and post. Nothing is posted. AI: 1 AI request.

tools.name: client_market_simulation_request
tools.description: Ask for a multi-agent market simulation for a client. It is queued as a request a person confirms, because it costs model usage.

tools.name: telegram_ads_draft_generate
tools.description: Builds a ready-to-submit Telegram ad within the 160-character limit with bid, budget and an impressions estimate, and reports whether it passes preflight. Amounts are in the Telegram account currency.

tools.name: telegram_ads_publish_task
tools.description: Creates a task for an operator to paste a checked ad into ads.telegram.org by hand. The path for accounts without an API token.

tools.name: chatgpt_ads_draft_generate
tools.description: Builds intent clusters and ad texts within the platform limits from a business description and returns them for review. Nothing is published. Takes up to a minute. AI: 1 AI request.

tools.name: campaign_draft_edit
tools.description: Low-level edit of a campaign draft before publishing: merge targeting keys, update ads, replace ad groups, rename, change goal, budget or UTM. Nothing is sent to the platform. Amounts are in the ad account's own currency, in whole units (not cents or micros).

tools.name: chatgpt_ads_review_sync
tools.description: Asks ChatGPT Ads for the review status of a campaign's ads and stores it in ADS Beast. Nothing is enabled: a campaign with no approved ad must stay off.

tools.name: leads_meta_ingest
tools.description: Pulls a client's Meta instant-form leads into ADS Beast now (scored, de-duplicated, forwarded to the client's webhooks). Idempotent.

tools.name: prepare_campaign_pause
